cover.title: reddit without getting banned

inner.title: be a redditor first
inner.body: reddit says it's fine to be a redditor with a website, not a website with a reddit account. an account that only drops links reads as spam.
inner.label: no ghost accounts

inner.title: the 10% rule
inner.body: reddit's self-promotion page says 10% or less of your posts and comments should link to your own stuff. the other 90% is the price of entry.
inner.label: 9 out of 10

inner.title: say i built this
inner.body: reddit tells you to identify yourself and never hide your link to your project. the fake happy customer always gets caught in the comments.
inner.label: own it

inner.title: read the sidebar
inner.body: reddit's user agreement lets moderators make and enforce their own subreddit rules. skip one and the best post you ever wrote still gets you banned.
inner.label: mods decide

inner.title: useful beats polished
inner.body: atilay candan shared his ai site report tool on reddit and saw 100+ signups within hours. nobody upvotes a landing page; they upvote help.
inner.label: 100+ in hours

closer.HEADLINE:
reddit isn't a channel.
it's a reputation
